name: review-desk
tagline: Chat in the middle, the diff and files beside it.
description: Review what an agent did without leaving the chat. The chat stays the main pane and every diff, file and link it opens lands in a column on its right; new terminals split instead of stacking as tabs; the edited-files card stays open; the tab bar gets Split Right, Split Down, Open Diff Viewer and Zoom buttons. Shift-Command-D opens the diff; in the diff, ] F and [ F step files, N and Shift-N step hunks, G G goes to the top. Two palette actions show the branch against main and start Claude to review it.

review-branch.title: Review: Branch Against Main
review-branch.tooltip: What this branch changes, file by file, in a new tab
review-branch.command: base=$(git symbolic-ref -q --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD || echo origin/main); git log --oneline "$base"..HEAD; git diff --stat "$base"...HEAD

review-claude.title: Review: Start Claude Here
review-claude.tooltip: Start Claude in a new tab in this folder, to review the branch with you
